highlights.title: Tailscale
highlights.text: Join Frangfurd over Tailscale: a direct connection with a lower ping that works when playit is down. Turn it on under Server in the chapter's settings.

highlights.title: Design overhaul
highlights.text: A compact sidebar, tools in the header, a downloads section above your account, and popups that lift out of the chapter card.

highlights.title: Distant Horizons terrain for Frangfurd
highlights.text: Download the server's distant terrain under World data in the chapter's settings and see the horizon from your first join.

highlights.title: UI improvements
items: A taller title bar on macOS, with the header buttons beside the window controls
The arrow cursor everywhere, and the text cursor only where text can be selected
Java arguments open and close in place
The pack details set against the column's right edge
A short intro that draws the wordmark as the launcher opens
This page, once after each update
